request.user_text:
SCENE HEADING: EXT. MUMBAI ROOFTOP — SUNSET

ACTION / DESCRIPTION:
EXT. MUMBAI ROOFTOP — SUNSET

A motorcycle tears across adjoining rooftops.
A drone follows while fireworks explode over the skyline.
Rain begins as the rider jumps to an adjacent building.

output.scene_summary: A high-octane motorcycle chase across Mumbai rooftops at sunset, featuring a dramatic building-to-building jump as rain begins to fall and fireworks light up the skyline.

elements.name: The Rider
elements.description: The protagonist/rider navigating the rooftops on a motorcycle.
elements.safety_notes: To be replaced by a professional stunt double for all riding and jumping sequences.

elements.name: Motorcycle Rooftop Jump
elements.description: High-speed motorcycle jump from one rooftop to an adjacent building.
elements.safety_notes: Requires ramp construction, structural engineering approval of both rooftops, catch-netting/airbags, and safety wire rigs for the rider and bike.

elements.name: Precision Rooftop Riding
elements.description: Riding a motorcycle at high speeds across narrow, adjoining rooftop paths.
elements.safety_notes: Rooftop edges must be clearly marked. Stunt rider must wear low-profile body armor under wardrobe.

elements.name: Hero Motorcycle
elements.description: Lightweight, high-performance dirt bike or dual-sport motorcycle modified for stunts and jumps.
elements.safety_notes: Requires daily mechanical inspection of brakes, suspension, and tires. One primary and one identical backup vehicle required.

elements.name: FPV Heavy-Lift Camera Drone
elements.description: High-speed tracking drone to follow the motorcycle jump and capture dynamic aerials.
elements.safety_notes: Must be operated by a licensed pilot. Flight path must not cross directly over the stunt rider's trajectory.

elements.name: Practical Rain FX
elements.description: Rain towers or overhead spray bars to simulate rain starting during the jump.
elements.safety_notes: Water must be carefully managed to avoid making the motorcycle launch ramp slick, unless specifically prepped for wet-stunt traction.

elements.name: CGI Skyline & Fireworks
elements.description: Digital enhancement of the Mumbai skyline at sunset, adding explosive fireworks in the background.

elements.name: Stunt Rig & Ramp Removal
elements.description: Digital removal of safety wires, launch/landing ramps, and safety catch equipment.

elements.name: Rider's Tactical Outfit
elements.description: Weatherproof, durable riding gear designed to accommodate low-profile stunt harness and protective pads.

elements.name: Wet Wardrobe Duplicates
elements.description: Identical duplicates of the rider's outfit to maintain continuity between dry and wet takes.

elements.name: Sweat and Dirt Continuity
elements.description: Grime, sweat, and minor road-dirt makeup for the rider/stunt double.

elements.name: Motorcycle Engine & Rain SFX
elements.description: High-revving engine audio, tire screeches on concrete, and sudden onset of heavy rain patter.

elements.name: Rooftop Edge Barriers
elements.description: Temporary safety railings and fall-protection systems for crew members working near rooftop edges.
elements.safety_notes: All crew working within 10 feet of the roof edge must wear safety harnesses attached to certified anchor points.

stop_conditions: Wind gusts exceeding 25 km/h (unsafe for drone operation and motorcycle jump stability).
Unplanned wetness on the launch ramp or takeoff zone prior to the jump execution.
Loss of direct radio communication between the Stunt Coordinator, Rider, and Drone Pilot.
Loss of ambient sunset light (magic hour window closed).
continuity_notes: The transition from dry to wet: The motorcycle and rider's wardrobe must start completely dry and show progressive wetness as the rain begins.
Bike damage: Ensure any scuffs or dirt on the motorcycle match prior scenes.
Sunset lighting: The sky gradient and light direction must match across all coverage angles, requiring careful scheduling during the golden hour.
